name: context-engineering
description: Select and load the minimum repository and runtime context for bounded agent work.
---

# Context Engineering

1. Start with repository constitution and the active requirement.
2. Load only architecture/domain/API contracts needed by the next step.
3. Prefer symbol and section summaries over full-file retrieval.
4. Rank evidence by relevance, authority, freshness, and policy.
5. Preserve provenance and hash identity while summarizing raw content.
6. Stop, checkpoint, or request focused evidence when the context budget is exhausted.
7. Never place secrets or unrestricted personal data in prompts or summaries.
